findings.location: Opening, Ecclesiastes 12:1 quotation and the following quoted phrases

findings.location: Genesis 2:18–24 and Genesis 1:26–28 quotations, including the repeated quotation of Genesis 2:18 and Genesis 1:27
findings.source_quote: “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field ... and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:18-24).
findings.suggested_fix: Translate each quoted passage into Bokmål; retain the corresponding localized book names and the exact chapter and verse numbers and reference placement.
findings.translation_quote: “And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field ... and they shall be one flesh” (1 Mosebok 2:18-24).
